title: 早上七點羽球場
subject: two retired couples playing their weekly grudge doubles badminton match at seven a.m. in the community sports centre, with a bottle of soy milk as the prize
caption: Mandarin funk band pop in the live 1970s horn-band style. Tight live drums on a sixteenth-note hi-hat groove; slap-and-pop electric bass; chicken-scratch rhythm guitar; a trumpet, tenor sax and trombone section hitting sharp stabs and short unison riffs; a Hammond organ with percussive clicks. Dry tight band room, punchy bass and kick, bright horns. Male tenor, punchy and comic, trading call-and-response lines with group backing vocals. 108 BPM, E minor. Sweaty, cheeky and bouncy. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no synth bass, no disco strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - funk guitar and horn stabs]

[Verse 1]
早上七點 活動中心 地板還涼涼的
王伯伯 綁好護膝 說今天要報仇
王媽媽 揮兩下拍 先把汗擦一擦
我老婆 拉拉筋 說我們上禮拜輸好慘

[Pre-Chorus]
一瓶豆漿 押在網子下
誰輸誰請 不准賴帳

[Chorus]
殺球 殺球 老骨頭也會跳
救球 救球 膝蓋先別叫
比分十九比二十 心臟快跳掉
早上七點 我們最會鬧

[Verse 2]
王伯伯 一個假動作 球輕輕放網前
我衝上去 球鞋飛掉 全場笑到彎腰
王媽媽 說不算不算 我說怎麼不算
裁判是管理員阿姨 她說先去撿鞋

[Pre-Chorus]
一瓶豆漿 還在網子下
最後一球 大家都不講話

[Chorus]
殺球 殺球 老骨頭也會跳
救球 救球 膝蓋先別叫
二十二比二十 豆漿我來倒
下禮拜七點 換你們來鬧

[Outro - horn tag]
下禮拜 再來
